title: Existence of Hermitian metrics with prescribed Hermitian-Yang-Mills tensors I
summary: In this paper, we solve the prescribed Hermitian-Yang-Mills tensor problem. Let $ E $ be a holomorphic vector bundle over a compact Kähler manifold $(M,ω_g) $. Suppose that there exists a smooth Hermitian metric $ h_0 $ on $E$ such that the Hermitian-Yang-Mills tensor $ Λ_{ω_g}\left(\sqrt{-1} R^{h_0}\right) $ is positive-definite. Then for any positive-definite Hermitian tensor $ P\in Γ\left(M,E^*\otimes \overline E^*\right) $, there exists a unique smooth Hermitian metric $ h $ on $E$ such that $$Λ_{ω_g} \left(\sqrt{-1} R^h\right)=P.$$ The proof is based on a new comparison theorem for…
